Shot Tracer® • Live Tracer • 3D Map Tracer • Putt Reader • Golf Video Editor • Live Scores

Turn Every Shot Into Broadcast-Quality Content.

Shot Tracer® is the world's leading golf ball tracer, golf video editor, and golf content creation platform, trusted by golfers worldwide and recognized by Golf Digest and Golf Magazine.

Create stunning TV-style golf videos, relive your best shots, improve your putting, and share your game like never before directly from your iPhone or iPad.

ONE-TIME APP PURCHASE INCLUDES

Everything you need to start creating golf content immediately:

LEGACY TRACER

The original Shot Tracer® video editor.

• Add professional ball tracing lines to your golf videos
• Fast and intuitive manual editing
• Create TV-style graphics
• Perfect for practice sessions, tournaments, and social media

PUTT READER™

Bring broadcast-style green reading technology to your game.

• Augmented reality green reading
• Visual putt lines and slope analysis
• Understand break, speed, and aiming points
• Improve putting confidence and green reading skills

LIVE TOUR SCORING

Follow professional golf in real time.

• Live scoring from major professional golf tours
• Track players, leaderboards, and tournament action

UPGRADE TO PRO

Unlock the complete golf content creator toolkit.

LIVE TRACER™

Create real-time tracers while recording.

• Automatic ball flight tracking
• Real-time tracer generation
• Fully customizable tracer styles
• No special hardware required

3D MAP TRACER™

Relive your shots from a stunning bird's-eye perspective.

• Flyovers on 44,000+ golf courses worldwide
• Cinematic shot replays
• Showcase strategy, landing zones, and shot placement
• Professional aerial-style visualizations

PRO EDITOR™

Create broadcast-quality golf videos directly on your phone.

• Automatic ball flight tracking
• Broadcast-style scoreboards and graphics
• Video-in-video overlays
• Custom logos, text, and branding
• Voice-over and captions
• Sound effects library
• Alpha channel export support
• Professional editing workflows
• Faster rendering and exports

PROFESSIONAL SCORECARD EDITOR

Create animated scorecards in seconds.

• 44,000+ golf course scorecards worldwide
• Professional scorecard templates
• Fully customizable animations and graphics

AR FUN MODE

Create unique golf content for social media.

• Hit virtual targets and hoops
• Shoot down UFOs and moving targets
• Create engaging golf challenge videos

MORE FEATURES

• 44,000+ golf course database
• Golf GPS and distance tools
• Digital scorecards
• iPhone and iPad support
• Weekly feature updates and improvements

Whether you're a casual golfer, coach, content creator, golf influencer, or tournament organizer, Shot Tracer® gives you the same visual storytelling tools used in professional golf broadcasts.

Created by golfers for golfers.

results.releaseNotes:
Introducing Shot Statistics & Club Gapping
Your golf videos are now more than just highlights they're becoming a complete record of your round.

Make sure GPS is enabled and that you've granted Shot Tracer and Live Tracer location access. Every video you record with Live Tracer will automatically be GPS tagged, allowing Studio Editor to accurately place every shot on the course map.

Automatic Shot Mapping

As you import your videos into Studio Editor, it automatically:

Places every shot on an interactive course map.
Calculates the distances between shots using GPS.
Matches each shot distance to the right club.
Creates animated Mini Maps automatically.
Animates the shot distance.
Displays the remaining distance to the pin after every shot.

No manual calculations. No extra work.

Powerful Club Statistics

After your round, open the new Stats page to discover:

Average distance for every club in your bag.
Complete Club Gapping analysis.
Every shot you've hit with each club.
Individual shot distances.
Elevation change for every shot.
Wind direction data for every shot.

Expand any club to review every shot individually and better understand your performance.

 Improve Your Game

The new Stats system helps you:

Learn your real on-course distances.
Build accurate club gapping.
Identify consistency and distance patterns.
Make better club selections.
Analyze every round like a professional.

And because every shot is automatically mapped and animated, it's also the perfect way to tell the story of your round with beautiful broadcast-quality graphics.

This is just the beginning we're building the most advanced golf video and shot analysis platform available.

Enjoy the update, and as always, thank you for supporting Shot Tracer!

Our biggest update ever is here!
NEW: LAUNCH MONITOR
Your iPhone is now a launch monitor. Get ball speed, distance, apex and spin rate, all included in the Shot Tracer Pro package on iOS, without expensive launch monitor hardware.
Connect it to Live Tracer and display your shot data directly on your live video feed in real time. Ball flight tracing and launch monitor data, together in one powerful experience.

NEW: STUDIO EDITOR LAYOUT PRESETS
Your shots. Your round. Automatically edited.

Choose a layout preset, select your videos and let our AI-powered Studio Editor do the rest. From a few shots to a full 18-hole round, create a polished golf video with stunning graphics, distances, 3D Map Tracers, automatic camera tracking and ball flight tracing in seconds. No manual editing needed.
